observation.visible_scene: Nighttime view of a residential front yard dominated by a large cone-shaped LED Christmas-tree display topped by a glowing star. The tree's surface shows a pixel-art face (two eyes with eyebrows, a nose, and a mouth) above a green-and-yellow striped base. Behind it is a single-story house with a red illuminated sign reading roughly 'TUNE TO ... FM' and a row of snowflake-shaped light decorations on the roofline; a car is parked on the left and a thin cable runs diagonally across the upper left of the dark sky.
visible_changes: The mouth of the pixel face continuously cycles through different shapes across the frames: a closed grin, a grin showing a row of dark 'teeth', a grin with a red tongue, and occasional wide-open dark 'O'/singing shapes.
The eyes, eyebrows, nose, the star, the green-yellow base, the house, the red sign, the parked car and the snowflake decorations remain essentially fixed in position and appearance throughout.
The camera is stationary; the background and tree do not translate or zoom, so the only clear motion is the on-tree facial animation.
outside_clip_unknowns: The audio or music track that the face animation is presumably synced to (implied by the 'TUNE TO' sign but not visible).
What expression or pattern the tree shows before t=0 and after the last frame.
Whether the snowflake decorations are meant to rotate or are static.
uncertain_details: Possible very slight rotation of the snowflake lights is not clearly confirmable from the frames.
The exact wording/number on the red sign is blurry (appears as 'TUNE TO 104.97.9' or similar).
Whether mouth-shape changes align to specific beats cannot be determined without audio.
